integrity: The claimed new contribution is the quantitative finite-threshold converse, its cycle-rank certificate, and exact unicyclic delay. Earlier forest and three-support results are credited. No independent review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Inverse girth theorem assumes an infinite binary support with arbitrarily long zero blocks.
Exact first-defect arity and value are asserted for unicyclic graphs, not arbitrary graphs with multiple cycles.
Aperiodic lower-envelope and cycle-to-excess implications are cited from the 2026 source; finite scripts are corroboration only.
title: Girth recovered from the first Abelian pattern-complexity defect
